_header.description: RM-9 (plan 611) metamodel residue adjudication baseline. suppressions[] = point hits keyed `ruleId::path::normalizedLineText` — CONTENT-anchored (directive 2026-10-19: live-tree constraints must not key on line numbers; keys survive edits above the line and identical statements share one adjudication). registry[] = adjudicated range/by-design items (their `ref` fields are historical pointers, exempt from the rule). Unregistered hits fail check:audit-renderer-metamodel-residue. Shrink-only: --update-baselines may remove vanished suppressions but never adds entries (roadmap Cross-Cutting 6; new exemptions require human confirmation). Format migration 2026-10-19: `ruleId::path:line` -> content key, entries remapped from HEAD line contents.
_header.adjudication: suppressions 11 (deduped to content keys: identical statement forms share one adjudication): A5-frame-wrap (6) — the frame family's deliberate path members after RM-2 (compiled-contract pass-through, resolver input, wiring, consumer, meta resolution); B7 (3) — base-definition optional component widened by RegisteredRendererDefinition plus the opaque compiled face; A8 (3) — the TemplateNode renderer-type triad carrier declarations (rendererType=living, TemplateNode.type=test-only, component.type=consumer-less; dead-carrier contraction owned by successor). registry 4: roadmap explicit-exclusion trio + the §5.3 snapshot-volume constraint (awaiting human confirmation on machine-ization).

defineRendererFamily assertion — roadmap explicit-exclusion list; live form is a single `as RegisteredRendererDefinition` (renderer-definition-builder.ts:37), the report's 'double assertion' wording is superseded by RM-1 registry typing.

RendererDefinitionShape 28-field grouping comments — roadmap explicit-exclusion list; live interface carries 24 top-level members (renderer-definition-types.ts:114-146), the 28→24 delta being the four channels removed by RM-1/4/5/6. Absence-type item, no point location.

Static snapshot volume must not grow — a constraint, not a detectable finding; machine-ization needs a snapshot-size baseline design first. Enforced at review time by Cross-Cutting 2. Human confirmation on whether to machine-ize is pending (plan 611 Phase 2).
